title: Blond Fighter in White Outfit
description: A LEGO-style humanoid minifigure with light skin and tousled, medium-length blond hair swept in chunky strands. The face has simple black eyebrows and eyes with a small neutral mouth, giving a focused expression. The figure wears an all-white outfit resembling a wrap-style top with a V-neck opening; thin black lines outline the folds and edges. A dark reddish-brown belt wraps around the waist with small pouch-like shapes on the front. The legs are white with tan/gold printed wrap patterns around the upper thighs and knees, plus thin black seam lines near the hips and lower legs. The figure holds a bright, translucent light-blue glowing blade extending straight upward from a metallic silver cylindrical hilt; the hilt has a slightly wider emitter section and ring-like details. Overall color scheme: white with black line accents, reddish-brown belt, tan/gold leg detailing, silver hilt, and light-blue blade.
